correctness.rationale: Definition 3 in Gabrić–Sawada reduces over binary symbols to 0^ell 1 followed by r-1 bounded zero-gap blocks 0^ei 1, 0<=ei<=ell, sum ei=z-ell. This bijection yields the coefficient enumerator. Every nonmonochromatic primitive rotation orbit contributes exactly one admissible start per longest zero-run, implying N<=Q<=z N. Burnside formula has leading r^(z-1)/z! and bounded-composition count r^(z-1)/(z-1)!, so Q/N -> z for each fixed z, including z=1 separately. Independent full binary enumeration through length 12, 777 primitive-orbit checks, and fixed z large-r integer checks passed; unrestricted result is analytic.
